primaryEvidence.read: Fresh indexed original abstract, methods, results and discussion. DirectPMC returned a captcha; no bypass.
primaryEvidence.verified: Four cohorts,2525 patients; untreated follow-up censored at treatment. Hemorrhagic presentation and age independently predicted hemorrhage; size did not in the multivariable models. Exclusively deep drainage in this analysis differs from any deep drainage in surgical grading. Current questions do not conflate them.
